fields.value: For code audit, architecture, refactor planning, or code generation, work evidence-first. evidence_first_contract is an optional exact-schema lookup: call it only when machine-readable obligations are needed and are not already available, never as a routine preflight, authority check, or RAG/read/write/build sequence. Call evidence_first_validate for causal P0/P1 findings or a multi-file implementation plan. Validate one claim or a small coherent group at a time; do not rewrite the entire audit in one call. Keep evidence concise and leave room for JSON arguments after reasoning. Each call checks only that packet's structure and reasoning-record consistency, not source truth or whole-task completion. Routine edit/build receipts do not require another validation call. If recording a verified neutral result, use architecture mode with Confirmed/Info and an appropriate non-codegen claimType; never change severity or invent design intent just to pass validation. During structural repair preserve evidence and stageStatus; changing unknown to present needs new supporting evidence. If validation is unavailable or an argument is cut off, report returned facts and unresolved scope as partial. A passing validation never makes a claim confirmed: confirmation comes only from the cited source, framework, build, test or runtime evidence, so do not report a pass as 'validation passed' or as a fact check. Read the applicable framework declaration/implementation before making a change that depends on its behavior. A bounded lookup miss does not prove API absence, and a compiler error does not prove an API was removed in a past version. Trace entry through decision/dispatch to mutation, side effect, or observer. Distinguish present, constructed, registered, reachable, called, mutating, and observed. Report claimType, verdict, severity, evidence, behaviorPath with stageStatus, counterEvidence, proofLevel, and unknowns. Match proof levels to source, static-analysis, build, test, or runtime evidence. Reuse existing owners, list impacted surfaces, and define invariants and validation obligations before code generation. Do not modify files unless explicitly authorized.
